sessionId.description: The exact chat session bound to the surface that captured this focus.

a1.description: A1 address or range, optionally sheet-qualified.

revision.description: Committed workbook revision at focus capture time.

cacheCoverage.description: Coverage evidence for the selected range cache.

cacheComplete.description: True only when every selected cell was loaded; previewTsv is authoritative only in this state.

formulaResultsFresh.description: False means selected formula results are cached or stale and must not be treated as authoritative numbers.

calculationStatus.description: Engine calculation status captured with this focus.

capturedAt.description: Unix time in milliseconds when the focus snapshot was captured.

previewTsv.description: Optional tab-separated preview, present only when cacheComplete is true and selected formula results are not stale.

valueSummary.description: Optional coarse stats such as numeric/empty/formula counts.
